title: Quality Chair; easy assembly; works good
text:
Quality Chair; easy assembly; works good. This is a little better than a basic office chair. It was easy to assemble. Probably didn't take more than 15 minutes. Includes an Allen wrench which is the only tool you need to assemble it. It is reasonably comfortable. I haven't tried sitting in it all day, but seems fine for several hours.
At first I thought they had sent the wrong seat, as the holes didn't line up on the bottom of the seat for the bracket for the back. They do line up, but I had the bracket in the wrong direction; it only works one way, so you can't make a mistake on assembly. I would have preferred a chair with arms and I think this same chair must be available with arms, as there were mounting holes in the seat for arms. If you buy a chair with arms and don't want or need the arms, you can always remove them, but it is nice to have that option. This model doesn't have the arms and that's okay if that's what you are looking for. If you spend a lot of time in front of a computer, as I do, you probably want a better chair, but this is a good chair, especially if you aren't sitting for hours. I would probably buy it again if I needed another chair, but I would opt for the model with arms next time.
